rows.name: Aider with Ollama
rows.reason: Terminal codebase workflow connects locally served Ollama models for collaborative coding. Narrower than general tasks; verify model compatibility and sufficient context.

rows.name: OpenCode + OpenRouter
rows.reason: OpenCode/OpenRouter supports a potential terminal workflow; exact model remains unspecified. OpenRouter hosting is not prohibited. Verify routed checkpoint: public weights permit acceptance, closed weights conflict.

rows.name: Claude Sonnet 4
rows.reason: Claude Sonnet 4 remains unresolved, not an open-weight recommendation. Hosted access, ASL-2 and older 2023 controls do not establish release-specific weight availability; obtain a distribution statement.

rows.name: OpenCode with a local open-weight model
rows.reason: OpenCode supports terminal agents through compatible local servers. Open harness does not supply open weights; choose a tool-capable model and configure context/tool parser. Pre-cutoff documentation version unverified.

rows.name: Qwen Code
rows.reason: Qwen Code provides an open-source terminal agent alongside Qwen3-Coder. CLI and model server are separate; explicitly configure open weights and assess noncoding tasks. Current provider/agent features are undated.

rows.name: goose with an open-weight model through Ollama
rows.reason: Goose with Ollama/open weights documents terminal research, writing, automation, analysis and coding. Useful behavior depends on models/extensions; exact Qwen3-Coder quality for unspecified noncoding tasks remains unverified.

rows.name: Open Interpreter
rows.reason: Terminal agent with switchable harnesses and OpenAI-compatible providers offers open-model adaptation. Current implementation differs from older descriptions; local compatibility/performance need evaluation, and no pre-cutoff version was verified.

rows.name: Claude Sonnet 4
rows.reason: The release offers Sonnet 4 through Claude and hosted APIs, not downloadable model weights; selecting it would not provide the requested open-weight alternative.

rows.name: Aider with a local open-weight model
rows.reason: Terminal repository pair-programming documents Ollama integration. A narrower choice for coding: configure the local model and adequate context. General automation parity remains unestablished.

rows.name: Qwen Code with Qwen3-Coder open weights
rows.reason: CLI/model family forms a documented terminal pairing. Select downloadable weights such as Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct; hosted names/subscriptions do not establish weight availability. Hardware fit and endpoint configuration untested.

rows.name: CursorFX
rows.reason: CursorFX customizes Windows mouse pointers, animations, and sounds; it supplies neither an AI terminal agent nor model weights for coding or general task execution.

rows.name: OpenCode with an open-weight model through Ollama
rows.reason: Terminal coding harness documents local Ollama integration but supplies no weights itself. Explicitly select open weights and verify installed-version tools; current vLLM auto-discovery disables tools until configured.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
rows.reason: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct supplies public weights, not a terminal workflow by itself. It requires an inference runtime, compatible tool calls and harness; local memory requirements were not assessed.

rows.name: OpenCode + OpenRouter
rows.reason: OpenCode provides the terminal agent and OpenRouter can serve open-weight Qwen3-Coder; keep the combination if an open-weight model is selected, although inference remains hosted.

rows.name: goose
rows.reason: Goose offers terminal-capable general-purpose assistance, local models, workflows and extensions. Task coverage and reliability depend on model/tools/extensions; current local-inference features lack historical dating.

rows.name: Qwen3-Coder
rows.reason: Open coding/tool model weights need a terminal harness such as Qwen Code. Announced 480B total parameters demand substantial resources; vendor benchmarks were not independently tested.

rows.name: CursorFX
rows.reason: CursorFX customizes Windows cursors, animations, effects and sounds. It supplies neither a terminal AI-agent workflow nor a language model; scope mismatch is independent of unresolved model-weight licensing.
